# ADR-3009: A01: Prefer centralized policy-as-code for access family 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Scattered checks drift across services.

## Decision

Teams SHOULD prefer centralized policy-as-code for access family 9 (A01-9) when authorization rules grow complex.

## Consequences

Policy reviews track ownership of each rule pack.
